Reads the output PDB movie file from RASPA into separate configurations, including the chemical symbols and
cell dimensions. 

## Parameters

| Name           | Type   | Description                | Default    |
|----------------|--------|----------------------------|------------|
| `path_to_file` | str    | path to the RASPA PDB file | _required_ |
